title: fix(plugin-approvals): re-issuing a restored approval continuation proves the pause past the first 1000 parked runs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DX6HgHjCbUTACRbNAr419qF)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czGci1wfPnGZhkvrcF

Fixes #28271

Clause-②: no (a re-issue on a store with more than 1000 parked runs now proves the pause as it already does below that; no schema, accept set, error code or result field changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批的「恢复后重发」(`continueRestoredRun`) 的 GUARD 3 改为按 run id 键读这个 run 停在哪个节点（新增引擎成员 `AutomationEngine.suspensionOf(runId)`），不再在 `listSuspendedRunsDurable()` 的 1000 行首页里找。
- 为什么改：实测 main（`69ce01d7`）：两个副本共用一个 `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`，前面已挂起 1000 条别的 run，副本 `a` 搁浅并恢复一个驳回决定，副本 `b` 重发：每次都以 `INVALID_STATE` "parked at no node this engine can see" 拒绝，连试 3 次一样，决定永远落不了地；998 条时正常。
- 风险与回滚：只换了「run 停在哪」这一步读法；期望节点的推导、不在暂停或停在别的节点照旧拒绝、重发本身都没变。新成员只读，一次按 id 读，用的是 `hasSuspendedRun` 同一个严格读法，存储读不出时抛错。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` 的 `suspensionOf`，与 `approval-service.ts` 里 `continueRestoredRun` 的 GUARD 3。
- 两分钟验证：先 build `@objectstack/service-automation`，再 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/restored-approval-continuation.test.ts`（预期 20 passed）与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/suspension-of.test.ts`（预期 4 passed）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位在 CI 绿后按落地授权落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: one new public read, `suspensionOf(runId)`.** It loads the run's suspension by id through `loadSuspendedRunStrict`, the store-authoritative loader `hasSuspendedRun` uses, and answers `{ runId, flowName, nodeId, correlation }`, or `undefined` when the run is not suspended. One keyed read, never a listing. It rejects when the store cannot be read, as `hasSuspendedRun` does. It sits beside `suspendedMapParentOf` (#28268). No other engine hunk.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`.** `ApprovalResumeSurface` declares `suspensionOf?` (optional, fail-closed: an engine without it is refused, as an engine without the listing was). GUARD 3 of `continueRestoredRun` reads `suspensionOf(runId)?.nodeId` instead of the run's entry in `listSuspendedRunsDurable()`. The refusal texts are unchanged except the missing-reader one, which now names `suspensionOf`. `listSuspendedRunsDurable?` stays declared (the interface is exported); its docblock now says this service no longer reads it.
- **Tests.** `suspension-of.test.ts` (new, service-automation) pins the engine member. `restored-approval-continuation.test.ts` (plugin-approvals) gains a `#28271` block over two replicas and one `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore`, reusing the file's existing engine double, so `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` is untouched.
- **`.changeset/28271-restored-continuation-past-first-page.md`.** `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` and `@objectstack/service-automation`, patch.

## Why

### Before (measured at `origin/main` `69ce01d7`)

Replicas `a` and `b` share one `ObjectStoreSuspendedRunStore` and one table set. N `paused` rows of another flow are stored first. On `a`, a `deal_approval` run parks, its `reject` decision strands (the reject branch throws), and `restoreConsumedSuspension` re-arms the pause. On `b`, `continueRestoredRun` re-issues it.

| | N = 1000, before | N = 998, before | N = 1000, after |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `b.hasSuspendedRun(run)` | `true` | `true` | `true` |
| run on `b.listSuspendedRunsDurable()` | no | yes | no (no longer read) |
| `continueRestoredRun`, 3 tries | refused each time: `INVALID_STATE: run '…' is parked at no node this engine can see, …` | `resumed: true` | `resumed: true`, the reject branch runs |

The listing reads one 1000-row page of `paused` rows in driver order, and a process adds only what it parked itself. So the run is missed exactly when another process (a replica, or this one before a restart) parked it behind more than 1000 runs, and a retry reads the same page.

### Why this path

Triage 6535230031: a keyed read by run id, the same kind as `suspendedMapParentOf`, still fail-closed when the run is not parked. The strict loader is the one GUARD 2 (`hasSuspendedRun`) already reads, so GUARD 2 and GUARD 3 now ask the same store the same question; the listing's own merge also let the durable row win (#14332), so below the page nothing changes. On an outage GUARD 2 already throws before GUARD 3 is reached.

### Other `listSuspendedRunsDurable()` callers

Grepped (`git grep -n "listSuspendedRunsDurable\|readSuspendedRuns"`, non-test). GUARD 3 was the only caller that looks up a single run. The rest:

- `engine.ts` `listSuspendedRunsDurable()` itself — the operability listing; a page is its contract.
- `subflow-guards.ts` `parkedRunsOf` → `readSuspendedRuns('throw', flowNames)` — per-flow, read to its end with `listByFlow` (#20725); not a page.
- `runtime/src/domains/automation.ts:1628` reads the synchronous in-memory `listSuspendedRuns()`, not the durable listing, for a listing, not a single-run lookup.
- The revise-window recall's batch lookup moved off the listing in #28268.

## Tests

`suspension-of.test.ts` (4 cells): a parked run answers its node, also on a second engine over the same store with nothing in memory; the answer follows the run to its next pause on another engine and is `undefined` once that engine completes it (no stale memory answer); an unknown id answers `undefined`; a store whose `load` throws rejects.

`restored-approval-continuation.test.ts`, `#28271` block (5 cells):

1. past the first page, the pause `a` re-armed is proved on `b` and the decision is re-issued; the reject branch runs (red on `main`: refused "parked at no node this engine can see");
2. CONTROL: within the first page (998) it is re-issued as before;
3. CONTROL: past the first page, a run parked at another node (the revise window after a send-back) is still refused, and the refusal names `wait_revision` (red on `main`: it named no node);
4. CONTROL: past the first page, a run that is not parked is still refused — by GUARD 2, and by GUARD 3 on an engine without `hasSuspendedRun`;
5. CONTROL: an engine without `suspensionOf` is refused with `INVALID_STATE`, and the pause is left in place.

Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:

| Ablation | Red |
|:---|:---|
| A1: GUARD 3 reads the listing again | `#28271` cells 1 and 3 |
| A2: GUARD 3 drops the node comparison | PIN 7, `#28271` cells 3 and 4 |
| A3: GUARD 3 drops the missing-reader refusal | `#28271` cell 5 |
| A4: `suspensionOf` answers from this process's memory, not the store | engine cells 1 and 2; `#28271` cells 1, 2 and 3 |

## Verification

Head `c4e208a4`, after a whole-tree `turbo run build`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and an unshallow fetch; `@objectstack/service-automation` rebuilt after the engine edit (plugin-approvals tests import its dist).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation run test`: 236 files, 2973 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals run test`: 106 files, 1366 passed. Both packages' `typecheck` (including `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 64 families, all exit 0. `--ran`: 64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:objectql-double-limit` are green with no ledger edit.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.

Skills-docs: none. `git grep -n "listSuspendedRunsDurable\|parked at no node\|continueRestoredRun\|suspendedMapParentOf" -- skills content docs` has no hit; `git grep -il "restoreConsumedSuspension\|re-issue the continuation" -- skills content` hits only `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, whose restore paragraph does not describe the listing or a page cap.

## Acceptance notes

- `run-history.ts:463-465` (`readSuspendedRuns`' degrade-path comment) still says "plugin-approvals' restored-continuation proof refuses on an absent entry, so a short list costs it a retry". After this PR that proof no longer reads the listing, so the sentence is stale; the comment's conclusion (keep the level at `warn`) still holds. Outside this card's file surface; not edited.
